technique_name: Write a summary of John Grisham's novel "A Time To Kill".
description: Set in rural Mississippi, John Grisham's "A Time to Kill" is the story of a ten-year-old African-American girl who is brutally raped by two white men. Her father, Carl Lee Hailey, takes the law into his own hands and attempts to assassinate the two perpetrators. When his trial comes to court, the county is embroiled in a chaotic trial that captures the attention of the world. With the help of his lawyer, Jake Brigance, Carl Lee is able to bring to light the injustices faced by African-Americans
